reference.title: The effect of multiple-dose, oral rifaximin on the pharmacokinetics of intravenous and oral midazolam in healthy volunteers.
reference.abstract: Overall, 3-7 days of rifaximin 200 mg 3 times/day did not alter single-dose midazolam pharmacokinetics. Rifaximin also does not appear to induce intestinal or hepatic CYP3A activity.
